name: TGI-Ring
tag: Wearable reminders for hemiplegia patients
team: Jin Zican, Wang Bo, Wen Ruiyang
description: A ring-based wearable that supports stroke survivors with reduced thermal sensation, warning against heat and cold hazards with real-time temperature sensing, LED indicators, and Peltier-based "pain illusion" feedback.

name: Pulsewave Glove
tag: Feel music through light and vibration
team: Huang Chenghao, Lu Yumeng, Xu Wangshu, Yuan Jilei, Zhang Zhinan
description: A plug-and-play glove that captures surrounding audio and translates it into synchronized vibration and light, helping people with hearing impairments feel rhythm and connect in music-driven settings.

name: Micro-Turbine Hydro Harvesting
tag: Compact energy from low-head water flow
team: Ambrose Yew Hao Qiang, Lim Rou Yi, Muhammad Haikal, Russell Daniel Yeo Wei Ming
description: A scalable, low-maintenance bulb turbine housed in a nozzle-diffuser casing, built to harvest renewable energy from low-head water flow and help cut carbon emissions from the energy sector.

name: Gait X
tag: A smart wearable shoe for gait analysis
team: Chen Guanjun, Lyu Jiaxun, Ma Xinkai
description: An intelligent insole combining pressure and motion sensors with a transformer-based deep learning model to deliver clinical-level gait analysis, instant LED alerts, and posture coaching through an app.

name: Blended Wing Distributed Propulsion
tag: Fixing take-off lift with distributed thrust
team: Jared Tham Jia Le, Joseph David Chan
description: Blended wing body aircraft cut fuel burn at cruise but struggle at take-off and landing. This project flight-tests model aircraft with distributed propulsion to recover lift, stall speed, and manoeuvrability.

name: Growth Optimisation of Cyanobacteria
tag: Tuning light to grow carbon-capturing microbes
team: Aaryana Aroop Pradhan, Ahluwalia Pahaul, Naadiah Bte Mohamed Ibrahim
description: Cyanobacteria are microscopic organisms that absorb CO2 and synthesise sustainable biomaterials. This research tunes light intensity, wavelength, and light/dark cycles to optimise their growth for carbon capture.

name: NUS Calibur Robotics
tag: Battle robots for the DJI RoboMaster championship
team: 50+ member multidisciplinary student team, est. 2019
description: A multidisciplinary team of over 50 students designing, fabricating, and programming seven specialised combat robots to compete at the DJI RoboMaster University Championships.

name: CubeSat Propulsion (CRADLE-M3)
tag: 3D-printed titanium thrusters for tiny satellites
team: Darryl Lim Zhen Hao, Wang Wei Lin
description: A 1U titanium-alloy CubeSat thruster made by powder-bed fusion, built as a cheaper alternative to bulky off-the-shelf propulsion. A vacuum chamber test rig validates its thrust under simulated space conditions.

name: Sustainable Monitoring of Flora and Fauna
tag: Computer vision for wildlife conservation
team: Anurag Mahlawat, Kevin Samuel Sumanam, Ng Xin Le
description: Built with Mandai Wildlife Reserve and NParks, this camera-based system uses computer vision to detect and study birds automatically, visualizing trends that feed into conservation strategy.

name: Katalog
tag: 4,563 Kickstarter projects, made tangible
team: Ho Yi Jing
description: A collection of 24 booklets cataloguing every product design project on Kickstarter in 2017. Booklet thickness maps to project volume, and color bleeds visualize funding trends across the dataset.

name: DUET
tag: A marble-powered musical instrument for two
team: Prasanth Kumar, Alexandra Arguelles, Gan Jie Lin, Sim Ee En, Ian, Julian Tan, Huang Zhiyuan
description: A dual-sided wood-and-metal instrument where players exchange colored marbles along tracks. Sensors read each marble’s color and travel time to trigger pitch and note duration, turning play into music.

name: Typodont+
tag: The first simulator that feels a root touch
team: Luke Goh Xu Jie, Loh Yue Xuan Chantel, Hugo Jean Guillaume Bourguignon
description: Orthodontic mini-screw insertion demands precision most training can’t simulate. Typodont+ is the first practice simulator that detects root contact, giving students a safe space to build skill before real patients.

name: Nim Coffee Table
tag: Furniture moulded from blended denim and cotton
team: Bryce Lim, Madeline See
description: A three-legged coffee table showcasing the mouldability of blended fabric. Starch-saturated denim, cotton, and a 3D-printed mould combine two colors into one seamless single-piece form with no joinery at all.

name: Healthcare Utility Box (HUB)
tag: A smart cabinet for hospital-at-home care
team: Gabriel Wong Kong Yee, Goh Guan Hao, Ryan Tan Cheng Lee
description: A home-delivered cabinet system that uses RFID and a cloud database to streamline patient care inventory for Mobile Inpatient Care-at-Home nurses, with an adjustable work area and built-in IV drip hook.

name: Workstation on Wheels
tag: An under-10kg mobile clinic for home-care nurses
team: Danyel Tan Tze Zen, Nur Sakhina Binti Jamal, Sara Wong Hui Xian
description: An all-in-one lightweight luggage under 10kg that streamlines packing and transport for home-care nurses, with specialised drawers, a built-in IV drip stand, and a deployable workstation table.

name: Fusilli
tag: Algorithmically grown, 3D-printed wrist accessories
team: Clement Zheng
description: A collection of elastic wrist accessories 3D-printed in polyamide, their forms generated from periodic mathematical formulae. A Leap Motion sensor lets you sculpt new designs by moving your hand through space.

name: Leaf Sampling Drone
tag: Reaching 70m rainforest canopies for research
team: Bryan Lim Min Kwang, Loh Yun Ying, Oung Yong Sheng Kennedy, Tan Sian Hern Ivan-Darien
description: A drone-based solution with a foldable boom and adjustable sampling tool that collects leaf samples from rainforest treetops up to 70 metres tall, supporting ecophysiology and foliar nutrient research.

name: Bumblebee
tag: Autonomous vehicles that navigate the open ocean
team: Student-run multidisciplinary robotics team, est. 2012
description: A student-run team building Autonomous Underwater Vehicles and Autonomous Surface Vessels that navigate independently from shoreline to deep water, competing at RoboSub and the Maritime RobotX Challenge.

name: Monchi
tag: A mealtime companion that grew into a snack guard
team: Feng Guozi, Yang Jun Wei, Gabriella Edith Tan Rui
description: Inspired by the playacting nature of toys, Monchi began as an entertaining mealtime companion-cum-container to coax fussy children into eating their veggies, then found a second calling protecting hands during messy outdoor snacking. Successfully funded on Kickstarter in 2021 with $34,559 from 766 backers.

name: Low-Cost Carrier Economy Seat
tag: More comfort without costing cabin space
team: Mageshkumar Kirubasankar, Ramie Lim Rui Min
description: An ergonomically redesigned economy seat for low-cost carriers that reduces shear force and relieves pressure points across a range of body types. Its isolated reclining mechanism improves comfort without compromising cabin space, while FSR pressure maps, posture tracking, and surveys guide testing.
